supervision.qualification: unweighted full-history complete-window and last256 strata

sequence: gold-seeded three whole-sequence shallow transformer-plus-projection passes; one causal shift; one-stage gradient credit
bootstrap: both distinct gold embedding projections immediately; gentle transformer adaptation after both held plateaus; plateau is not qualification
resume: full model, heads, Muon, scheduler and RNG; changed inputs or objective require fresh qualification

checkpoint_selection.ranking: qualified first, then worst normalized held gate ratio across every stratum; no prompt-volume sum
checkpoint_selection.retention: latest emergency/resume state plus best full state and serving heads; atomic hardlinks avoid duplicate GPU serialization; verify best receipt SHA before using paired files
checkpoint_selection.handoff: changing code/data starts a fresh selection comparison; full Muon/RNG/model continuation retained

held_probe.geometry: bounded first and last windows per fixed selected document; no lexical-prefix bias
held_probe.provenance: selected document hashes, factual groups and group-order digest recorded; splits unchanged
held_probe.coverage: periodic bounded probe is diagnostic; broader source-group qualification required before release
